pinning.Name: Pinning
pinning.Hint: When on, each pinned player sees the scene their pinned character's token is on and ignores GM scene activation; moving the token moves the player, and a GM 'Pull to Scene' moves them too. Turning it on checks that every pinned character has exactly one token and brings online pinned players to their token.

Notify.AuditOk: Pinning on: all {n} pins have one token.
Notify.Stranded: {actor} ({user}) has no token left: until it is placed again, {user} follows scene activation like an unpinned player. Place {actor} again and {user} is brought to it (at their next login if offline).
Notify.Paused: {actor} ({user}) now has {n} tokens ({scenes}): the view follows only the copy on the scene {user} is viewing. Delete the extra one.
Notify.GatherViewUnchanged: Gathered, but the view did not follow for: {users}

Audit.NoActor: {user} is pinned to a deleted actor
Audit.GmUser: {user} is a GM and is pinned to {actor}
Audit.NotOwner: {user} cannot observe {actor}: their view follows a token they get no vision from

Gather.CombatBody: {names} will leave the combat tracker (moved to another scene).
